title: Senior Personal Injury Case Manager (100k+ Settlements & Paralegal Demand Experience)
job_title: Senior Personal Injury Case Manager (100k+ Settlements & Paralegal Demand Experience)
description: Schedule: Full time | Must work U.S. Pacific Time (California) Department: Pre-Suit | Plaintiff Personal Injury Reports To: Managing Attorney About the Role We are a fast growing, results oriented Plaintiff Personal Injury law firm seeking a highly experienced Senior Case Manager to step into a high responsibility role. You will manage high value personal injury cases from intake through settlement and close out. You will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, coordinating medical treatment, managing complex insurance claims, preparing polished demand packages, and ensuring strict compliance with all deadlines. We are looking for a true professional who thrives in a fast paced remote environment, communicates directly, and can manage a high volume of details without dropping the ball. If you are just looking to coast, this is not the job for you. If you are driven by results, value clear systems, and want to be rewarded for your hard work, we want to talk to you. Key Responsibilities Client Communication & Case Management: • Serve as the primary client contact via phone, email , text, and client portal. • Onboard new clients and clearly set expectations from day one. • Provide regular case updates with empathy and professionalism. • Maintain organized, highly detailed case notes and next actions in our case management system. Insurance Claims & Coverage: • Open and aggressively manage Bodily Injury, MedPay/PIP (if applicable), and UM/UIM claims. • Rapidly obtain declarations pages, policy limits, and adjuster information. • Request, track, and file UM/UIM Selection or Rejection Letters for applicable policies. • Ensure complete and timely coverage verification for every file. Deadlines & Compliance: • Calendar and meticulously track California deadlines, including the 2 year statute of limitations and municipal/ante litem notice deadlines. • Maintain a standard of zero missed deadlines and perfectly accurate documentation. Medical Treatment & Records: • Coordinate medical provider referrals under attorney direction. • Monitor treatment progress and MMI status. • Request, track, and strictly quality check HIPAA compliant medical records and bills. Liens & Subrogation: • Open and tightly manage Medicaid, Medicare, ERISA, and private health insurance liens. • Obtain final lien demands and assist with aggressive reductions. Demands, Settlement & Close Out: • Prepare highly polished demand packages, including liability summaries, damages narratives, medical specials spreadsheets, and supporting exhibits. • Support settlement negotiations for high value cases under attorney supervision. • Process settlements, releases, disbursements, and case close out checklists. Performance Metrics (KPIs): We use KPI tracking to reward high performers with bonuses, not for micromanagement. You will be measured on: • Time from assignment to demand and settlement. • Coverage completeness (UM/UIM letters and verified limits secured within 30 days). • Medical records turnaround time and first pass completeness. • Zero missed deadlines and clean CRM documentation. • Time Zone Integrity: Strict adherence to 9 AM - 6 PM Pacific Time. You must be actively online, responsive, and working solely for our firm during these hours. Qualifications: • Proven plaintiff personal injury pre-suit case management experience. • California PI experience is strongly preferred (or a rigorous willingness to learn CA specific rules). • Deep working knowledge of UM/UIM, MedPay/PIP, medical billing terminology, and complex liens/subrogation. • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills. • Highly organized, detail oriented, proactive, and tech savvy. • Prior experience working effectively in a fast paced environment. • Reliable, professional, and comfortable working completely independently in a remote setting. Technology & Tools • Experience with at least one major PI case management system (Filevine, Needles, SmartAdvocate, Lead Docket). • Comfortable with Microsoft 365. • Familiar with e-fax, e-signature tools, and VOIP systems. (Training is provided for firm specific tools.) Compensation & Benefits: • $2,500 USD Monthly, paid bi-weekly. Negotiable depending on experience. • 40 hour work week from 9 AM to 6 PM Pacific Time. • Aggressive performance bonuses tied to KPIs (Up to $1,000 USD). • Full time, long term position. • An efficient team environment with well defined processes, direct collaboration with a U.S. attorney, and major opportunities for growth. Why Join Our Firm • Stable, long term remote role (not project based) • Direct collaboration with U.S. attorney • Well defined processes and realistic expectations • Opportunity to grow with a plaintiff side personal injury practice How to Apply: To prove you have read this entire job description, you must start your application or email subject line with the exact phrase: "California PI Closer - [Your Name]". Applications without this subject line will be immediately archived. Workspace & Application Requirements: To support a successful remote work environment and ensure you are set up for long term success, applicants MUST include the following in their proposal: • A short Loom video introduction (2-3 minutes max). In this video, you MUST verbally answer Question #4 (The Furious Client scenario). Show us exactly how you would speak to this client to de-escalate the situation. • A brief view of your dedicated workspace. • A screenshot confirming your internet speed (Minimum: 50 Mbps Download) and computer specifications (Minimum: 8GB RAM, i5 processor or equivalent). (These materials help us ensure long term success in a fully remote role.) Answer the following questions when applying: 1. You have a California auto-collision file. The at-fault Geico policy is $15k/$30k. Your client's ER and physical therapy bills total $42,000, and they have an active ERISA health insurance lien. Walk me through your exact step-by-step strategy to get this file closed and put money in the client's pocket. 2. An adjuster from State Farm is refusing to tender a $100k policy limit, arguing that the client's MRI findings (a 3mm disc bulge) are degenerative and not related to the rear-end impact. What specific evidence and arguments are you putting in the demand letter to force them to pay? 3. You inherit a messy Filevine dashboard with 40 pre-litigation files. 10 are waiting on medical records, 5 are ready for demands, and 3 have upcoming statute of limitations deadlines in 60 days. How do you prioritize your first 48 hours on the job? 4. A client calls you absolutely furious. It’s been 8 months since their accident, they just finished treatment a week ago, and they are demanding to know why they don't have their settlement check yet. They threaten to fire the firm. Walk me through exactly how you handle this call, de-escalate the situation, and reset their expectations. 5. You get a new intake for an intersection collision. The police report incorrectly places your client 100% at fault, but your client insists the other driver ran a red light. The other driver is claiming your client ran the light. What are your immediate next steps to flip liability and find coverage?

title: 3D Modeling/CAD Designer
description: Speed Industries is looking for a skilled Virtual Assistant with strong 3D modeling and CAD design experience to support our fabrication, laser cutting, powder coating, and product development work. This role is ideal for someone who understands manufacturing, can take rough ideas or marked-up drawings and turn them into clean, usable CAD files, and can help reduce the design workload for our internal team. The right person will be detail-oriented, organized, responsive, and comfortable working remotely with a fast-moving fabrication company. The primary focus of this position will be creating, revising, and preparing 3D models, 2D drawings, flat patterns, and production-ready design files for manufacturing. Key Responsibilities 3D Modeling & CAD Design Create and revise 3D models for fabricated parts, assemblies, brackets, guards, frames, fixtures, signs, and customer products. Develop CAD models from sketches, photos, measurements, customer drawings, or verbal direction. Prepare clean and accurate part files for CNC laser cutting, tube laser cutting, press brake forming, welding, and powder coating. Create and update 2D drawings with dimensions, notes, material callouts, bend details, hole sizes, tolerances, and revision history. Generate flat patterns, DXF files, STEP files, PDF drawings, and other required production files. Assist with converting customer-supplied files into usable manufacturing drawings. Check designs for manufacturability, including bend allowances, material thickness, hole spacing, weld access, hardware clearance, and powder coating considerations. Drawing Packages & Revisions Prepare professional drawing packages for shop use and customer approval. Revise existing drawings based on feedback from customers, shop employees, or management. Maintain organized file naming, folder structure, and version control. Clearly mark changes and communicate revision updates. Help standardize Speed Fabrication’s drawing templates, title blocks, notes, and CAD file organization. Manufacturing Support Work with Speed Fabrication’s team to help translate ideas into buildable products. Support laser cutting, fabrication, and powder coating projects with accurate CAD files. Assist with product development for online products, Shopify items, Etsy products, customer jobs, and repeat manufacturing work. Identify potential design issues before parts reach the shop floor. Help create repeatable designs that improve efficiency and reduce rework. Required Skills Strong experience with 3D CAD software such as: Fusion 360 SolidWorks Inventor AutoCAD Onshape or similar professional CAD software Ability to create accurate 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings. Ability to export DXF, STEP, PDF, STL, and other common file types. Understanding of sheet metal design, bend lines, flat patterns, material thickness, and formed parts. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings. Strong attention to detail. Good written communication skills. Ability to follow directions, ask smart questions, and work independently. Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely. Ability to organize files clearly and consistently. Preferred Experience Experience designing parts for CNC laser cutting. Experience with press brake forming and sheet metal fabrication. Experience with tube laser or structural fabrication. Experience creating weldment drawings or fabrication assemblies. Experience designing products for powder coating. Experience working with American units: inches, fractions, decimals, gauges, and material thicknesses. Experience creating customer approval drawings. Experience with manufacturing businesses, job shops, or custom fabrication companies. Basic understanding of hardware, fasteners, weld symbols, tabs, slots, bend reliefs, and tolerances. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is not just a CAD operator. They are someone who thinks through how a part will actually be made. They should be able to take an idea like, “We need a bracket that bolts here and holds this panel,” and turn it into a clean model and drawing that the shop can manufacture with minimal back-and-forth. They should be organized, responsive, and capable of working with limited information while still knowing when to ask questions. job_title: Life Manager (Project Manager) - Remote Full Time
description: Hello, we are looking to hire a life manager to support our agency and founder with the agency’s day-to-day operations This is not a personal assistant role and not a traditional executive assistant role You will help design, manage, and run systems across both work and personal life so everything operates smoothly, predictably, and with minimal mental overhead The goal is not just to complete tasks, but to reduce decision fatigue, improve organization, and create leverage through systems, structure, and proactive execution What success looks like in this role? • Fewer things falling through the cracks • Clear priorities every day and week • Tasks and projects move forward without constant reminders • Life and business logistics feel “handled” • Less chaos, more clarity If that sounds exciting to you, this role fits! Core responsibilities Daily / Ongoing • Managing tasks, reminders, and follow-ups • Keeping systems organized and up to date • Tracking priorities and deadlines • Proactively flagging issues or bottlenecks • Communicating clearly and concisely Weekly • Light project management and coordination • Reviewing open loops and unfinished items • Improving existing systems and workflows • Preparing summaries and updates Ongoing improvement • Creating structure where there is chaos • Documenting processes • Suggesting better tools or workflows • Learning fast and adapting to new responsibilities What we care most about (non-negotiables) • Full-time dedication only This must be your only professional role. Question 3: Please share your portfolio. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. Question 4: What makes a static ad effective in your opinion? Question 5: Are you looking for a full-time, long-term role? Important To apply, start your application message with the word Creative on the first line. title: Amazon Account Manager
description: We are looking for a highly reliable, professional, and experienced **Amazon Virtual Assistant with strong Customer Service experience** to join our growing eCommerce team. This role is a combination of **Amazon Seller Central support, daily account operations, and customer service management**. We need someone who can take ownership of tasks from start to finish, follow SOPs carefully, and resolve issues with minimal supervision. We are looking for a proactive “closer” — someone who can manage Amazon-related tasks, handle customer concerns professionally, protect seller metrics, and support the overall health of the account. --- ## Job Requirements — Non-Negotiable **Experience:** Minimum of **2 years of straight, consecutive experience** as an **Amazon VA and/or Amazon Customer Service Specialist**. We are looking for stable work history, not job-hopping experience. Accepted examples: * Company X: Jan 2023 – Present * Company Y: Feb 2022 – Feb 2024 Not accepted: * 3 months in one company, 6 months in another company, then another short contract. **Amazon Seller Central Knowledge:** Must have hands-on experience navigating Amazon Seller Central, including buyer messages, account health, orders, returns, refunds, cases, and basic Amazon operations. **Customer Service Experience:** Must have experience handling Amazon buyer messages, customer complaints, refunds, returns, damaged/missing items, “delivered but not received” cases, cancellations, negative feedback, and customer escalations. **Autonomy:** Must be confident working independently, following SOPs, making sound decisions, and resolving issues without constant supervision. **Availability:** Must be willing to work **40 hours per week on Eastern Time**. **Work Setup:** Must have a stable internet connection, backup internet preferred, and a quiet professional working environment. **Communication Skills:** Must be professional, clear, and calm when communicating with customers and internal tea ---------- mbers. --- ## Scope of Work ### Amazon VA / Seller Central Support * Monitor Seller Central notifications, account health alerts, and performance issues. * Check stranded inventory, suppressed listings, listing errors, and catalog issues. * Assist with opening, tracking, and following up on Amazon support cases. * Monitor inventory levels and flag low-stock or out-of-stock risks. * Download and organize Amazon reports when needed. * Update listings, pricing, images, backend keywords, or product details based on instructions. * Help maintain clean and accurate product information. * Support FBA/FBM order and inventory-related tasks. --- ### Amazon Customer Service Support * Manage Amazon buyer messages professionally and within Amazon response time requirements. * Handle refunds, returns, cancellations, damaged items, missing items, and “delivered but not received” cases. * Make refund or replacement recommendations based on company SOPs. * Prevent unnecessary escalations to A-to-Z claims or chargebacks. * Handle A-to-Z claims, chargebacks, and disputes carefully to help protect seller metrics. * Monitor negative feedback and product reviews. * Assist with professional outreach and feedback removal requests when allowed by Amazon policy. * Maintain a calm, professional, and customer-focused communication style. --- ## In Your Application, Please Explain / Confirm: 1. Your current location: **Metro Manila or Davao & Mid Sized Cities**. 2. Your exact Amazon work experience and consecutive work dates. 3. Your hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central. 4. The Amazon tasks you handled before, such as listings, inventory, cases, reports, buyer messages, refunds, or returns. 5. How you handle negative feedback and your process for requesting removal. 6. How you prevent customer issues from escalating to A-to-Z claims. 7. Your experience d ---------- or recommending refunds/replacements based on SOPs. 8. Your availability to work **40 hours per week on Eastern Time**. 9. Confirmation that you have a stable internet connection and quiet work setup. --- ## How to Apply — The Test To confirm that you have read the full job description, include the keyword **Amazon NY** in the subject line of your message. --- ## Ideal Candidate Profile **Detail-Oriented:** You catch small issues before they become bigger problems. **Customer-Focused:** You know how to communicate professionally, calm customers down, and resolve concerns properly. **Process-Driven:** You can follow SOPs and understand the importance of protecting seller metrics, account health, and customer experience. **Reliable & Stable:** You show up consistently, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work. **Proactive Problem Solver:** You do not wait for every small instruction. You identify issues, suggest solutions, and escalate only when needed. **Advantage:** Experience with Walmart, Shopify, Amazon FBM/FBA operations, or previous Amazon-related call center work in the Philippines is a plus.

title: Solar PV Design & Technical Specialist (Remote)
description: Role: Solar PV Design & Technical Specialist (Remote) We’re Solar Guys Pro, a fast-growing e-commerce startup simplifying the chaos of buying solar equipment. Whether you're building an off-grid cabin, a home backup system, or a full-scale solar array, we help customers get the right products, expert guidance, and fast delivery — without the usual complexity and delays that plague this industry. We don’t just list SKUs. We solve real operational problems, for both customers and suppliers by simplifying the supply chain of solar. In a space of outdated technology and inefficient systems, our vision is to become the most operationally efficient backend in the solar e-commerce space, built with smart systems, lean processes, and a laser focus on execution. We’re lean. We’re profitable. We move fast. No investors. No fluff. Just clean systems, clean energy, and clean execution. We're a small remote team with a bias toward action, ownership, and results. Every person here is a builder — not a bystander. Your mission is simple: - Build and maintain the technical foundation of our solar systems — every single day. - You will own the full technical function of a fast-growing 7-figure solar e-commerce company. -  From system sizing to full configurations, BOM creation to system standardization, you’ll ensure our technical engine is accurate, scalable, and efficient. - This is not a passive technical role. -  You won’t just “design systems.” - You will interpret requirements, question configurations, improve system logic, and build scalable solutions. - We’re looking for a detail-obsessed, fast-moving Solar PV Specialist with strong experience (2–5+ years), preferably in off-grid and hybrid systems. - You should be meticulous and structured — but also proactive, system-oriented, and two steps ahead. Someone who sees technical gaps before they arise and builds systems to prevent them. - You'll be the person ensuring our systems are complete, our configurations are accurate, our kits are install-ready, and our technical foundation is rock solid across all products, setups, and use cases. Work Schedule - This is a full-time remote role (8 hours/day). You must be fully available during 9 AM – 5 PM EST, M-F. Key Responsibilities 1. Solar System Design Own the full lifecycle of solar system design, including system sizing, architecture, and configuration Design off-grid, hybrid, and grid-tied systems based on real-world use cases Create complete system layouts (roof and ground mount) 2. System Configuration & Technical Accuracy Build complete, install-ready Bills of Materials (BOMs) for all systems Ensure all required components are included (wiring, breakers, mounts, etc.) Validate compatibility across all system components Identify and eliminate missing components, errors, and configuration risks 3. Technical System Logic & Standardization Define how products work together across all system types Build and maintain standardized system templates (e.g., 5kW, 10kW, off-grid kits) Reduce dependency on fully custom builds by creating structured, repeatable systems 4. Systems, Processes & Automation Maintain and optimize technical data across the Order Management System (OMS) and related tools Use Google Sheets and internal tools to build structured system logic, trackers, and configuration frameworks 5. Technical Strategy & System Development Act as the company’s technical truth source, ensuring all systems are accurate and reliable Identify technical inefficiencies, risks, or gaps — and proactively propose solutions Provide structured, scalable system logic that allows the business to grow efficiently without errors To excel in this role, you must be able/have the following: - 2–5+ years of hands-on solar PV system design experience (off-grid or hybrid strongly preferred) - Fluent in English, both written and verbal. Clear communication is critical - Strong understanding of system sizing, load calculations, and solar system architecture - Hands-on experience working with inverters, batteries, panels, and balance of system components - Experience building complete, real-world solar system configurations (not just theoretical designs) - Experience with solar design tools such as HelioScope, Aurora Solar, or PV*SOL - Strong Google Sheets skills (ability to structure systems, logic, and configurations) - Experience working in fast-paced environments with multiple system builds and iterations Personal Traits: - Highly detail-oriented — you notice when a single component is missing - Thinks in systems, configurations, and structured logic - Obsessed with clean, complete, and install-ready system builds - Strong problem solver who can turn technical complexity into clear solutions - Enjoys turning messy requirements into scalable, repeatable systems - Calm, responsible, reliable, and execution-focused What’s in it for you? ???? Competitive Salary – $1,000/month base + performance bonuses ???? Fully Remote – Work from anywhere with full flexibility ???? Growth & Influence – Be part of a 7-figure brand on track to scale fast, your work will shape the technical foundation of the company ???? 14 days paid time off – Recharge and refresh with flexible PTO ???? Performance Bonuses – Earn more based on output, speed, and accuracy ???? Creative Freedom – Take complex technical problems and build clean, scalable solutions How to Apply If this role sounds like a perfect fit,  we’d love to hear from you. Here’s how to apply: Step 1: Submit your CV/resume and a past project for solar design (PREFERABLY OFF-GRID WITH EG4 EQUIPMENT) Step 2 (If shortlisted): Complete a short 10-minute test task Step 3: Final interview with the CEO.

title: Architect
description: THIS IS A REPOST OF A RECENT JOB OPENING THAT IS NOT FILLED.  I had a couple of talented architects but we found we had some knowledge based gaps.  I found I need someone with a bit deeper skillset and who understands topography and US building standards better. Since this is a remote position some of these requirements will be tweaked.  You would be communicating with our team and clients remotely via email , WhatsApp, and possibly via video on FaceTime or Zoom.  I may tweak this description as I see what responses I get.  Thank you for taking the time to apply and for giving me all the info I need to make a great decision. Job Description Who We Are We are a small design-build custom home and renovation firm based in NC, serving the mountains of Western North Carolina. We handle everything in-house, from initial design through final construction, which means our designer isn't handing drawings off to someone else and walking away. You're part of the build from first sketch to finished product. We're a small, high-performing team that takes on fewer projects intentionally so we can do each one right. I have found that I need to include a bit of detail in the job post to see if you actually read it all.  I find that at least 50% don't read it all.  If you skip over all of these it means you are just blasting out responses and have no attention to detail and I will delete your application. Our clients are homeowners and investors who expect precision, professionalism, and a design partner who listens. We've built our reputation on doing exactly that. The Role We're looking for an Architectural Designer who brings real expertise and takes ownership of the design function. You'll work directly with clients from early concept through construction documentation, collaborating daily with our project managers and pre-construction team. You'll be in the “room” virtually” if needed for the conversations that matter. We want someone who brings strong judgment, exercises initiative, and raises the quality of our work. What You'll Do Lead design development across all phases, from initial programming and schematic concepts through design development and construction documentation Understand client design meetings and selections appointments, work with our interior designer and clients through material, finish, and specification decisions across multiple rounds Produce construction drawings and documentation that our project managers can build from without ambiguity Create renderings and visual presentations that communicate design intent clearly to clients In your response, tell me the difference between European & US style windows. Collaborate with pre-construction on design-driven cost estimates and value engineering decisions Maintain design intent through the build by staying engaged with the field team during construction In your response, tell me what hourly rate you need and your minimum and maximum hours you would work. Contribute to improving our internal design process as the company grows What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience in residential design, preferably custom homes or high-end renovation Required proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, and SketchUp or other similar software In your response tell me how big a 2x4 and a 2x10 is. Experience producing high-quality renderings for client presentations Working knowledge of US residential building codes and construction methods; familiarity with North Carolina codes is a plus A portfolio that demonstrates design sensibility, complete construction documents, and client-ready renderings In your response, tell me the clearances required for bathroom fixtures. Clear communicator who handles client relationships with confidence and works well without heavy oversight In your response, tell me why you are the right fit for this role. Familiarity with design-build delivery is a plus; genuine interest in how buildings get built is non-negotiable Bonus if you bring experience with: Rhino 3D, Grasshopper, ArchiCAD, Chief Architect, Adobe Creative Suite, or Bluebeam Salary Please provide your required hourly rate. Why This Role You'll have direct influence over a company's design direction, not executing someone else's vision as one of many. You'll work with a team that respects craft, holds high standards, and takes pride in the finished product. To Apply Send a sample of your work that would be ready to permit in the US market.  Apply directly through Onlinejobs.ph. Include your portfolio with your application, demonstrating your design work, construction documents, and renderings. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

job_title: 3ds Max & Rhino Expert – 3D/2D CAD File Conversion Specialist
description: We are seeking a highly experienced freelancer proficient in both **3ds Max** and **Rhino** to streamline our asset library. We have a large catalog of molding profiles currently saved in native `.max` files. The goal of this project is **not** to manually redraw everything from scratch. Instead, you will open the existing 3ds Max files, extract/export the usable geometry, and convert them into a clean, production-ready CAD library. --- ### Key Responsibilities 1. Open native **3ds Max .max files**. 2. Inspect files to check if they contain original splines, profile curves, sweep/loft profiles, or bevel profiles. 3. Export usable 2D profile curves as **DXF/DWG**. 4. Export 3D models as **OBJ/FBX/STL**. 5. Bring the exported files into **Rhino**. 6. Create clean master 2D molding profiles. 7. Prepare **laser/waterjet-ready DXF files** for 2D blade cutting. 8. Create clean **STEP files** for Fusion 360 and external CAD vendors. 9. title: Energy modeling specialist
description: You are a building energy modeling specialist. You have 3 to 7 years of hands-on experience running full building energy simulations and you know the difference between a well-built model and a model that simply runs. You take modeling seriously and your work product reflects it. You are an IES VE expert. IES Virtual Environment is your primary simulation tool. You know it deeply: you can build geometry from scratch, assign constructions, configure HVAC systems, set up occupancy and lighting profiles, run compliance checks, and interpret results. You do not need to be trained on IES VE. You know ASHRAE 90.1-2022 inside and out. You have applied both the Energy Cost Budget (ECB) method and the Performance Rating Method (PRM) on real projects. You understand the mandatory requirements, prescriptive path, and how the compliance pathways differ and when each applies. You are proficient in the 2024 IECC. You understand the 2024 International Energy Conservation Code commercial provisions including the mandatory requirements, prescriptive compliance path, and Energy Rating Index (ERI) compliance options. You can navigate Section C401 through C408 without looking everything up. You understand building systems at a technical level. Envelope assemblies, U-values, SHGC, infiltration rates, HVAC system types and efficiencies, lighting power densities, and plug loads are part of your everyday vocabulary. You know how modeling assumptions affect results. You are a strong communicator. You write and speak English at a professional level. You can explain complex energy model results to engineers, architects, and clients in a way that is accurate and understandable. This is a requirement, not a preference. You are detail-oriented and self-directed. You catch your own errors before they become client-facing problems. You manage your time, meet deadlines, and produce deliverables that do not require extensive rework. WHAT YOU WILL DO Perform complete building energy simulations using IES VE for new construction, major renovation, and retrofit projects across multiple building types including Healthcare, Mission Critical, Higher Education, and Government facilities. Conduct ASHRAE 90.1-2022 compliance modeling using both the Energy Cost Budget (ECB) method and the Performance Rating Method (PRM). Document the baseline building configuration, proposed design, and performance results in accordance with the standard. Perform 2024 IECC commercial energy compliance analysis including mandatory requirements review, prescriptive path compliance verification, and trade-off calculations. Produce compliance documentation suitable for submittal to authorities having jurisdiction (AHJ). Model all major building systems within IES VE including building envelope assemblies (walls, roofs, floors, fenestration), HVAC systems (air-side and water-side), domestic hot water, lighting systems, plug loads, and on-site renewable energy where applicable. Evaluate energy conservation measures (ECMs) through parametric modeling. Run multiple design scenarios, compare results, and provide clear recommendations with supporting data to help clients and design teams make informed decisions. Collaborate with commissioning engineers to compare modeled system performance against installed equipment schedules and sequences of operation. Identify discrepancies and support the commissioning process with energy-based analysis. Coordinate with project architects and MEP engineers of record to obtain accurate model inputs including construction assemblies, equipment schedules, ventilation rates, and occupancy data. Document all assumptions clearly and maintain an assumption log for each project. Prepare clear, professional energy model reports documenting methodology, inputs, results, and conclusions. Reports must be suitable for client delivery and regulatory submittal. Support Building Envelope Commissioning (BECx) efforts with thermal bridging analysis, condensation risk review, and energy impact assessment of envelope performance gaps. Stay current with code updates, standard revisions, and software developments. As ASHRAE standards and energy codes evolve, you will be expected to adapt modeling practices accordingly. POSITION REQUIREMENTS Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Building Science, or a closely related field (required) 3 to 7 years of hands-on building energy modeling experience on real construction projects (required) Proficiency in IES Virtual Environment (IES VE) is required and nonnegotiable. Candidates who do not have demonstrated IES VE experience will not be considered. INTERVIEW REQUIREMENT: All candidates must present a minimum of two completed IES VE energy models during the interview. Candidates will be expected to walk through their modeling approach, explain key assumptions, identify compliance outcomes, and answer detailed technical questions about the models. Presenting borrowed or template models is grounds for immediate disqualification. POSITION REQUIREMENTS -Demonstrated proficiency in ASHRAE 90.1-2022 including ECB method, PRM compliance pathway, mandatory provisions, and envelope and mechanical system requirements -Demonstrated proficiency in 2024 IECC commercial energy provisions including mandatory requirements, prescriptive compliance, and trade-off compliance paths -Familiarity with EnergyPlus or DOE-2 simulation engines is a plus -Exceptional English proficiency, written and verbal, at a professional business level (required, nonnegotiable) -Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and Outlook -Must be available to work hours that overlap with US Central Time (CST) business hours on a consistent, daily basis -Full time position, minimum 40 hours per week

title: Operations Manager-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company
job_title: Operations Manager-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company
description: Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. - High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos - Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company. - Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics. - Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 3 years with us is worth 10 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your peers by being on this team. - Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves! If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace. Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs. We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who: Can’t drive tasks to completion independently Mark tasks complete with no proof Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru Need hand-holding We don’t need another task hopper. Looking for a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. What You’ll Actually Do You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs: Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin) Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you Who This Is NOT For You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5 You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure Who This IS For You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here. Comp & Growth Start: $800/mo PH based, full time during 90 day trial. When you consistently hit our KPIs (Output, D3 standards, owns Slack/Asana, Culture score), & take on much more responsibility, total comp moves to $1,000/mo target month 4. High performers who carry more scope over time can earn $1,100–$1,200+ with expanded responsibility. Raises and benefits are tied directly to beating KPIs, & raising the standard, not time served If you crush it, scope grows into higher-level ops ownership and comp follows output. No ceiling. This is what you make it. How To Apply Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine): Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro ---------- ssy start to completion without delegating. What tools did you use to track it, what were the exact deliverables, and what was the measurable result? Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each. Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders. Also attach your PDF/Googledrive resume link Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.

title: Level 2 (Plus) IT Technician
description: Location: Fully Remote (Ph) Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST (with flexibility as needed for client impact events) About T3 Tech Partners T3 Tech Partners is the team MSPs rely on when challenges exceed Tier 2 or internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner, delivering advanced Microsoft 365, cloud, and security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments. Our engineers are trusted technical partners — leading implementations, resolving complex escalations, and working directly with MSP clients to execute real-world solutions. ________________________________________ Role Overview We are seeking a senior-level Cloud Solutions Engineer (Level 3) to lead advanced Microsoft 365 and cloud initiatives, handle complex escalations, and implement solutions directly with MSP clients. This is a technical, customer-facing role — while not sales-focused, you will regularly work directly with customers to design and implement the solutions required to meet their business and technical needs. This role requires strong technical depth, independence, and the ability to step into unfamiliar environments and software ecosystems with confidence. ________________________________________ Key Responsibilities Advanced Cloud & Escalation Support • Handle advanced and expert-level escalations related to cloud infrastructure and SaaS services. • Serve as a senior escalation point for Microsoft 365 and cloud-related issues across multiple MSP environments. • Perform root-cause analysis and implement long-term remediation for complex or recurring issues. • Work directly with MSP clients and end customers to execute solutions and improvements. Microsoft 365 (Core Focus Area) • Architect, deploy, optimize, and support Microsoft 365 environments end-to-end, including: o Exchange Online (mail flow, security, migrations, troubleshooting) o SharePoint Online and OneDrive (architecture, permissions, governance, performance, migrations) o Microsoft Teams (policies, governance, troubleshooting) • Perform and lead tenant-to-tenant migrations, including email , OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams data. • Execute server-to-cloud migrations, such as file servers to SharePoint or OneDrive. • Expert-level administration and troubleshooting of: o Microsoft Intune (endpoint management, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment, Autopilot) o Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) including identity lifecycle, SSO, MFA, and hybrid identity o Conditional Access policy design and enforcement o Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Office 365, Identity) o Microsoft Purview (data governance, retention, compliance, DLP) • Implement and maintain Microsoft 365 security best practices across client tenants. • Assist MSPs with tenant configuration, licensing strategy, and feature utilization. Third-Party Application Integration • Work with third-party software applications that integrate with Microsoft 365 (email , identity, security, document management, line-of-business platforms). • Support applications you may not have prior experience with, requiring: o Willingness to learn new platforms quickly o Ability to understand how third-party systems interact with Microsoft 365 o Troubleshooting authentication, permissions, data flow, and integration issues • Collaborate with vendors and MSPs to ensure proper configuration and supportability. Server and Infrastructure Support • Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and File Services. • Manage and support virtualization platforms (e.g., Hyper-V, VMware) in on-premises and hybrid configurations. • Perform server migrations, including lift-and-shift to Azure, P2V conversions, and workload transitions to cloud-hosted services. • Support and maintain backup and disaster recovery solutions, ensuring recoverability for both on-premises and cloud workloads. • Assist with decommissioning legacy on-premises infrastructure as part of cloud migration projects. Projects, Optimization & Automation • Lead cloud migration and optimization projects for MSP clients. • Optimize Microsoft 365 environments for security, performance, and cost efficiency. • Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and related administrative tasks. • Recommend improvements, standards, and long-term strategies to MSP partners. • Stay current on Microsoft 365 feature changes and emerging cloud technologies. Availability & Support Expectations • Standard working hours are 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST. • Some flexibility is required for high-impact client issues, critical changes, or migrations outside normal hours. • This role is not on-call, but responsiveness during critical events is expected. ________________________________________ Qualifications Required Experience • 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud solutions in an MSP or multi-tenant environment. • Expert-level proficiency in: o Microsoft 365 (all major workloads and admin portals) o Microsoft Intune o Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) o Conditional Access and MFA o Microsoft Defender and Purview • Strong experience with: o Tenant-to-tenant Microsoft 365 migrations o Server-to-cloud migrations (e.g., file servers to SharePoint/OneDrive) o Email and data migrations • Required experience with PowerShell for administration and automation. • Experience with Google Workspace and cross-platform migrations. • Expert-level understanding of SaaS security and cloud cost optimization. • General knowledge of infrastructure and networking concepts. • Proven experience working in MSP environments (required). • Excellent native-level English communication skills, both written and verbal.

description: NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAIL S REGARDING THIS POSITION. PERSONAL INJURY CASE MANAGER - Law Firm This position will start out part-time and transition into a full-time position (40 hours per week) for the right candidate. We are seeking a Personal Injury Case Manager to join our team and support our attorneys and paralegals in fighting for the rights of injured clients. What We’re Looking For: • A strong communicator who can build trust with clients and handle sensitive conversations with care. • An organized and detail-oriented professional who can manage multiple cases efficiently. • A proactive problem solver who anticipates next steps and keeps cases moving. • Experience in personal injury case management (preferred, but not required). • Familiarity with legal terminology, medical records, and insurance claims. • Tech-savvy with the ability to learn new case management software. • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. job_title: Level Up, Engr! Turn Your EE/ECE/ME Degree into a Global Trade Career with Korea
description: [Recruitment Validity Period] Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement. [Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent] - DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees. - DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers. - In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea. - Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea ---------- mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly. - DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role. [About the Position] - We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level) - This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program. - Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms. - The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea ---------- mbers will also provide guidance when needed. [Company Introduction Materials] - Company Introduction Video: ---------- - Company Facebook Page: ---------- [Responsibilities] - Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program - Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products - Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms - Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system - Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers - Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards - Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea ---------- mbers - Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner [Required Qualifications & Skills] This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products. - Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field - Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products - Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details - Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information - Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills - Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents - Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems - Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks [Preferred Experience] The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role. - Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists - Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems - Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support - Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data - Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents - Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery - Experience organizing data using Excel [Who We Are Looking For] For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing. This role is suitable for someone who: - Handles documents and numbers accurately - Can follow fixed formats and internal standards - Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed - Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently - Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly - Has an interest in global trade and technical products - Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important. [Training & Work Support] New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning. DYE provides the following training and support: - Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years - Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work - A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly - Guidance from internal tea ---------- mbers - Additional explanations from a tea ---------- mber who understands the current workflow [Compensation & Employment Terms] - This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates. - Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards. - Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates. [Compensation & Employment Terms] 1. Eligible Career Level - This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates. - Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards. Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates. 2. Payment Terms - Payment Term: Monthly basis - Probationary Period: 6 months 3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates - For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below. - Months 0–3: USD 280/month - Months 4–6: USD 300/month - Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months. The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases. 4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates - Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates. - For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position. - Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure. - Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary - Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary - For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6. - The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards. [After Regularization] - Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization. - Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation. - If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases. - Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review. [Perks & Benefits] 1. Regular Employee Benefits - 13th Month Salary provided - 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization 2. Performance-Based Incentives - Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent. - Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution. 3. Paid Holidays - January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays. - This applies to both probationary and regular employees. 4. Long Service Incentive Program - 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000 - 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500 - 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000 [How To Apply for the job] Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form ---------- Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their email s or Facebook ---------- [Closing Message] This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system. If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support. As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: Client Care Project Manager
description: ** Read the entire job description and follow the application process. Seriously inquiries only. Position Overview The Client Care Project Manager is responsible for owning internal execution flow, timelines, cross-department communication, and operational meeting facilitation across all client accounts. This role ensures that: - Work moves smoothly from strategy ? creative ? execution ? delivery - Information flows clearly across teams and client channels - Meetings are structured, productive, and action-oriented The Client Care Project Manager is the central coordination and communication hub of the agency. They do not own a strategy or creative direction. They own clarity, coordination, communication, and follow-through. Role Purpose This role exists to: - Create calm, predictable execution across teams - Ensure everyone knows what’s happening, what’s next, and who owns what - Translate decisions into action through clear tasks and timelines - Facilitate effective meetings that drive alignment and execution - Prevent miscommunication, dropped handoffs, and reactive fire drills Success Profile (How We Define Winning) The Win This role is winning when: - Teams are aligned without needing constant clarification - Meetings produce clear decisions and next steps - Projects move forward on time and without friction - Clients feel informed and confident - Risks are surfaced early, not after the fact - Paying attention to detail on all projects Ownership (What This Role Owns) - Ownership of project timelines and delivery coordination - Ownership of the cross-department communication flow - Ownership of the internal daily tea ---------- eting facilitation - Ownership of the Weekly Focus Tasks and agenda - Ownership of task clarity, priorities, and sequencing - Ownership of client-facing operational communication - Ownership of escalation when risks or blockers arise - Ownership of the Asana structure, accuracy, and hygiene Ideal Profile - Clear, concise communicator - Strong facilitator who keeps discussions focused - Proactive and calm under pressure - Highly organized and detail-oriented - Comfortable holding timelines and boundaries - Keeping others accountable - Able to manage their time wisely - Attention to detail - Be proactive, not reactive - anticipate what will be asked Core Responsibilities Project & Execution Management - Manage & own all client projects and task assignments through Asana - Translate strategy and creative direction into actionable task plans - Work closely with the Creative Director and Integrator - Assign tasks with clear owners, priorities, and deadlines - Maintain accurate timelines and delivery expectations - Track progress and follow up on outstanding work - Preparing project documentation Communication & Liaison Responsibilities - Serve as the primary communication liaison between: - Strategy - Creative - Media Buying - Clients - Ensure decisions and updates are communicated clearly across Slack, daily chat, and client channels - Filter and translate information so teams receive what they need without overload - Route questions to the correct owner and ensure timely resolution - Regularly communicating with clients Meeting Facilitation - Run and facilitate internal team calls - Collaborate with the Creative Director to prepare and distribute meeting tasks - Keep meetings focused, on time, and action-oriented - Capture decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines - Ensure meeting outcomes are reflected in Asana tasks - Follow up on action items post-meeting - Stay on top of client communications and outstanding items from clients Risk & Visibility Management - Monitor capacity and workload across teams - Identify and escalate risks, blockers, or scope changes early - Communicate priority or timeline changes clearly and promptly - Prevent last-minute emergencies through proactive coordination Operating Expectations - No task moves forward without clear ownership and a deadline - Meetings end with documented decisions and next steps - Communication is proactive, clear, and concise - The Client Care Project Manager acts as a facilitator and translator, not a bottleneck - Escalates issues early rather than absorbing them - Maintains trust by keeping systems and communication accurate Send us a 2-3 minute loom on why you would be a great fit for this role. And share your favorite food in the video. Growth & Evolution As we scale, this position may evolve into a broader leadership role, supporting additional project managers and building more advanced delivery and communication systems.

title: Manager, Creator Partnerships and UGC
description: The Manager, Creator Partnerships & UGC is the business owner of the MAG Creator Platform, My Amazon Guy’s proprietary system for managing user-generated content (UGC) and affiliate partnerships across 400+ brands. This role oversees the platform’s success end-to-end: strategy, operations, and team growth. Working alongside the Lead Developer, the Manager ensures the product roadmap, creator network, and campaign operations scale efficiently while meeting ROI targets for MAG’s brands. As the point leader for creator partnerships and affiliate-driven growth, the Manager will establish scalable workflows for onboarding, compliance, content approvals, payments, and reporting. title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description: About the role Atlas Geotech LLC builds spatial data solutions for the real estate and insurance industries — property hazard disclosures, cost estimates, and risk models. The accuracy and usefulness of our data, web apps, and information products they generate is the whole product, so we're hiring a QA specialist with genuine GIS expertise and an obsessive eye for detail. This is a remote role with room to grow with responsibility. You'll work primarily async, with a short daily overlap with US Pacific Time. What you'll do GIS data & output QA — the core of the role Verify how we use the data:  the highest-value checks: is a hazard flag derived from the correct layer, does an address geocode to the right parcel, is an cost figure computed correctly? Validate outputs against known-good reference cases. Verify our apps display the right thing:  maps, layers, and overlays render the correct data in the correct place, at the right zoom, with styling that reads clearly. Verify our reports tell the right story:  hazard disclosures and replacement cost reports are correct, coherent, and sensible — e.g., a parcel inside a fire-hazard zone is never reported as low-risk, figures are plausible, and the narrative matches the underlying data. Validate spatial data:  SRID / coordinate-reference-system correctness, geometry validity (ST_IsValid — self-intersections, invalid polygons), topology issues (gaps, overlaps, slivers), and the integrity of joins between spatial and tabular attributes. Spot-check positional accuracy:  confirm hazard zones overlay parcels correctly, addresses land in the right place, and reprojections (e.g., EPSG:4326 ? 3857) haven't silently shifted geometry. Verify GeoServer & GeoNode:  WMS/WFS GetCapabilities, layer bounding boxes, SLD styling renders as intended; and GeoNode metadata / layer configuration is complete and correct. Validate data parity across environments/migrations:  confirm a migrated or cloud copy of our data matches the source — row counts, geometry integrity, and query results identical across environments. Web app & API QA Test our API endpoints:  response schemas, status codes, pagination, auth, and the correctness of returned JSON and images. Test our map front-ends:  layer toggles, popups, click handlers, coordinate display, zoom behavior, tile loading, large-payload performance, plus basic cross-browser/responsive checks. Write clear, reproducible bug reports:  steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual, severity — and verify fixes. Required GIS fundamentals — the key requirement:  spatial queries, coordinate reference systems, projections and datum transformations, when to use raster vs. vector, geometry types, topology, and spatial data-quality concepts. This is the heart of the role — strong GIS judgment matters more than any single tool. Hands-on with a desktop GIS:  QGIS or ArcGIS/Esri. If your background is ArcGIS and you haven't used the open-source stack yet, that's completely fine — the fundamentals transfer well and we'll help you ramp on QGIS/PostGIS. Spatial SQL in PostGIS —  or a genuine willingness to learn it quickly (if you've written attribute queries or Definition Queries in ArcGIS, you're closer than you think). A real eye for detail:  you notice when something is subtly wrong, not just obviously broken. Communication:  clear written English and disciplined documentation habits. Required Skills * Hands-on experience with Wazuh * Basic understanding of SIEM and log management * Basic understanding of endpoint detection and response * Experience reviewing security alerts and system logs * Familiarity with Linux servers * Familiarity with Windows endpoint monitoring * Understanding of Wazuh agents, server, indexer, and dashboard * Ability to document technical findings clearly * Ability to follow checklists and standard operating procedures * Strong attention to detail * Reliable communication * Comfortable working remotely with task tracking and reporting tools ## Preferred Skills * Experience with cloud security monitoring * Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud logs * Experience with Docker or container monitoring * Experience with vulnerability detection workflows * Experience with file integrity monitoring * Experience with compliance reporting support for PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, NIST, or similar frameworks * Experience creating or reviewing technical reports * Experience with ticketing tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, ClickUp, Trello, or similar tools ## Important Role Boundaries This role supports security monitoring, documentation, and escalation. This role does not make final legal, compliance, audit, or certification decisions. This role does not guarantee that any client is compliant with HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR, or any other standard. The specialist will help monitor technical controls, document findings, and escalate items for manager review. ## Work Schedule This is a part-time remote role. Expected schedule: * 10 to 20 hours per week to start * Monday through Friday availability preferred * Daily monitoring check-ins required on assigned workdays * Weekly reporting required * Additional hours may be available based on workload and performance The final schedule will be confirmed before hiring. ## Example Work Routine A typical workday may include: * Check Wazuh dashboard health * Confirm active agents are connected * Review new alerts * Review vulnerability or configuration findings * Identify urgent issues for escalation * Update the monitoring tracker * Prepare a short daily report * Attend a short manager check-in when needed ## Compensation Compensation will be discussed during the hiring process based on experience, technical skill level, schedule availability, and assigned responsibilities. Payment schedule will be confirmed before work begins. Possible payment structure may include: * Hourly part-time pay * Weekly or biweekly payment schedule * Optional performance review after a trial period No bonus, raise, or long-term hours are guaranteed. Any future increase or expanded responsibility must be approved by management. ## Who This Role Is Best For This role is a good fit for someone who: * Has real Wazuh experience * Enjoys cybersecurity monitoring work * Can follow technical checklists * Can explain alerts in simple language * Is reliable with daily reporting * Can work independently * Knows when to escalate instead of guessing * Wants consistent part-time technical work ## Who Should Not Apply Please do not apply if: * You have never used Wazuh * You are not comfortable reviewing security alerts * You cannot work with Linux or endpoint monitoring tools * You cannot provide clear daily updates * You are looking for a non-technical virtual assistant role ## How to Apply Please send the following: 1. Your resume or work profile 2. A short summary of your Wazuh experience 3. Examples of Wazuh tasks you have handled 4. Your experience with Linux, Windows, cloud, or container monitoring 5. Your available work schedule 6. Your expected hourly rate 7. Your preferred payment schedule 8. Any screenshots or sample reports you are allowed to share, with private client data removed ## Screening Questions Please answer these questions when applying: 1. How long have you worked with Wazuh? 2. Have you installed or configured Wazuh agents before? 3. Have you monitored Wazuh alerts or dashboards before? 4. description: Legal AI Product Tester / Legal QA Analyst Remote | Contract | Philippines-Based Preferred About the Role Irys is looking for lawyers or legally trained professionals to test our legal AI platform on a daily basis. This role is focused on stress-testing legal AI workflows across litigation, corporate, transactional, research, drafting, and document-review use cases. You will use your own legal judgment, test sets, sample documents, pleadings, contracts, memos, and research tasks to evaluate whether the system produces accurate, useful, well-structured, and lawyer-reviewable work product. This is not a passive QA role. We need someone who can think like a lawyer, identify what went wrong, explain why it matters, and structure feedback clearly for our product and AI teams. Responsibilities Test Irys legal AI workflows daily across different legal tasks. Bring and create realistic test sets, including pleadings, contracts, memos, client email s, research questions, diligence materials, and mixed document bundles. Evaluate outputs for legal accuracy, factual grounding, completeness, structure, tone, formatting, and usefulness. Identify hallucinations, missed facts, weak reasoning, unsupported claims, bad drafting choices, citation problems, and confusing product behavior. Compare outputs across different modes, prompts, models, and workflows. Provide structured feedback with clear issue descriptions, severity levels, screenshots, source references, and recommended fixes. Work closely with product, engineering, and AI teams to reproduce issues and improve the system. Help define testing rubrics and repeatable evaluation sets for future benchmarking. What You Should Be Testing For Did the system understand the uploaded documents? Did it extract the right facts and miss anything important? Did it distinguish between fact, law, argument, risk, and client narrative? Did it cite or reference sources correctly? Did it draft in the right legal format? Did it over-admit, overstate, hallucinate, or make unsupported conclusions? Did it produce something a lawyer could actually review and use? Did the workflow make sense from a user perspective? Did any internal/debug language appear in the final output? Did the product behave reliably across repeated tests? Qualifications Law degree or substantial legal training required. Strong familiarity with U.S. legal documents, pleadings, motions, contracts, legal memos, and common law reasoning strongly preferred. Experience with U.S., U.K., Australian, Singaporean, or other common law legal work is a plus. Litigation and/or corporate/transactional experience preferred. Strong legal writing and analytical skills. Excellent attention to detail. Comfortable testing software, documenting bugs, and giving precise feedback. Ability to work independently and test consistently without needing constant direction. Interest in legal AI, legal technology, and product development. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a legally trained operator who can test like a lawyer and think like a product reviewer. You should be comfortable saying: This answer is legally wrong. This draft is useful but not filing-ready. This missed a key fact. This cited the wrong source. This workflow is confusing. This is a serious issue versus a minor polish issue. Engagement Remote contract role. Part-time or full-time depending on fit and availability. Daily testing expected. Paid trial period may be required. Must be able to provide structured written feedback in clear English. To Apply Please send: Resume or LinkedIn profile. Short summary of your legal background. Jurisdictions or legal systems you are familiar with. Examples of legal documents or workflows you would be comfortable testing. Availability and expected hourly or monthly rate. Any prior experience with AI tools, legal tech, QA, or product testing.
